claims.claim: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI began rolling out to paid ChatGPT Chat tiers Oct 7, extending to Free and Go Oct 8; work and Codex models were unchanged by this specific release. Current API docs list GPT-6.1 Sol standard short-context prices at USD 2 input, 0.10 cached input, 10 output per million tokens.
limits: GPT-6.1 Sol introduction page did not expose an explicit publication date in the retrieved text; report current documentation availability, do not invent release date.
Pricing page contains Standard/Batch/Flex/Fast/Ultrafast and short/long context; choose standard short context explicitly. Long-context prices differ.
Provider's performance charts are vendor-reported, not independently tested by us.

claims.claim: Pairwise user preferences aggregated into a rating.
claims.limits: Preference and style are distinct from factual correctness. Exact category/adjustment, dated vote cutoff, interval and votes matter.
claims.practical_implication_interpretation: Use for candidate assistant experience; test correctness and your tasks separately.

claims.claim: Weighted combination of ten evaluations. Categories: Agents30%, Coding20%, Scientific Reasoning20%, General30%.
claims.limits: Primarily English and text; different metrics transformed for a composite, weights reflect evaluator priorities. Not universal IQ; do not compare across index versions without recomputation.
claims.practical_implication_interpretation: A shortlist signal, followed by task-specific evaluation and cost.

claims.claim: Whether agents complete repository/terminal tasks under checked test criteria.
claims.limits: Model plus agent environment; compare harness/version/tools/budget. SWE bash-only1.x vs2.x are not automatically compatible.
claims.practical_implication_interpretation: Closer to repair/engineering workflows than a chat coding preference score, but not a guarantee of shipping a whole app.

claims.claim: Recall and calibrated refusal over 6,000 questions. Accuracy is correct/all questions; published hallucination rate is incorrect/(incorrect+partial+not-attempted), not incorrect/all answers.
claims.limits: Benchmark-specific denominator and synthetic question-generation/judge dependencies; lower hallucination alone can coexist with more abstention.
claims.practical_implication_interpretation: Look for correct answers and appropriate admissions of uncertainty, separately.

claims.claim: Find, connect and reason over100 questions with long documents(10k–100k tokens).
claims.limits: Grader uses LLM equality checking; context-window capacity alone says nothing about successful synthesis.
claims.practical_implication_interpretation: Evaluate actual long documents and evidence integration at your required length.
